question: Which type of OneStream dashboard is used to show the status of an application, including at-a-glance workflow status, end-user activity, vital signs, security, and audit details?

options.A: Executive dashboard
options.C: Administrator dashboard
options.D: Workflow navigation dashboard

explanation: C is correct: Administrator dashboards offer valuable insights into application and framework asset performance, including workflow status, end-user activity, vital signs, security, and audit details. A is incorrect — Executive dashboards present high-level financial data to executives. B is incorrect — Home page dashboards serve as a user's entry point. D is incorrect — Workflow navigation dashboards are for navigating workflow steps, not monitoring application status.

question: What is the relationship between MarketPlace solutions and OneStream dashboards?

options.A: Dashboards are another name for MarketPlace solutions.
options.B: Many MarketPlace solutions are built using OneStream dashboards.
options.C: MarketPlace solutions build dashboards.
options.D: MarketPlace solutions serve as individual components within dashboards.

explanation: B is correct: Many MarketPlace solutions, such as Guided Reporting and People Planning, are built using OneStream dashboards — the concept of building software on an existing platform is called 'software on software.' A is incorrect — they are not synonymous. C is incorrect — it is the reverse. D is incorrect — MarketPlace solutions are entire applications, not individual components.

question: What are two ways in which end users can access dashboards in OneStream? (Select 2.)

options.A: Via the application properties.
options.C: Via customized home pages.
options.D: Via the Dashboards section in the System tab.

explanation: B and C are correct: end users can access dashboards through Workflow (when a dashboard is attached to a workflow step) and through customized home pages. A is incorrect — Application Properties is an administrative configuration area. D is incorrect — the System tab is for administrator configuration.

question: What is a Workspace in OneStream?

options.A: A dashboard element that filters data using a list of restricted members.
options.B: A dashboard element used to apply filters to external data sources.
options.C: An organizational unit at the top of the structure that holds maintenance units, which contain dashboards.
options.D: An organizational unit that allows users to review task information and task status.

explanation: C is correct: a Workspace is the highest-level organizational unit in the dashboard structure. It holds Maintenance Units, which contain dashboards, Cube Views, components, parameters, and all dashboard elements. A is incorrect — that describes a parameter or filter. B is incorrect — that describes a data adapter function. D is incorrect — that describes Task Activity.

question: What is the purpose of a dashboard group in OneStream?

options.A: To organize dashboards within a maintenance unit.
options.B: To control where dashboards are used within the application.
options.C: To hold the structure that makes up dashboards.
options.D: To provide an isolated environment for development and testing.

explanation: A is correct: dashboard groups organize dashboards within a maintenance unit in the same way Cube View groups organize Cube Views. B is incorrect — that is the function of dashboard profiles. C is incorrect — dashboard groups organize dashboards, not their structural elements. D is incorrect — isolation for development is provided by separate Workspaces.

question: A user needs to access a dashboard in design mode. They have already selected the dashboard from the Workspace. What should they do next?

options.A: Click the Show Objects that Reference the Selected Item button.
options.B: Click the Set the Selected Dashboard as Default button in the toolbar.
options.C: Click the Clear Default Dashboard button in the toolbar.
options.D: Double-click the dashboard name to open it in design mode.

explanation: B is correct: after selecting the dashboard, clicking Set Selected Dashboard as Default opens it in design mode. A is incorrect — that shows what references a selected asset. C is incorrect — Clear Default removes the current default. D is incorrect — double-clicking opens properties, not design mode.

question: What is the purpose of a maintenance unit in OneStream?

options.A: Writing queries to BI Blend tables.
options.B: To hold and structure dashboards and all the elements necessary for creating dashboards.
options.C: To enable parallel processing for performance optimizations.
options.D: To manage user access and security settings for dashboards.

explanation: B is correct: a maintenance unit holds and structures dashboards and all necessary elements — components, data adapters, parameters, files, and business rules. A is incorrect — BI Blend queries use data adapters. C is incorrect — parallel processing is part of the calculation engine. D is incorrect — user access is managed through Groups and dashboard profiles.

question: Where are dashboards located within a Workspace in OneStream?

options.A: Dashboards are located directly within the cube.
options.B: Dashboards are located within members found within the Origin dimension.
options.C: Dashboards are located within maintenance units, which are held within Workspaces.
options.D: Dashboards are located directly within the Workspace, outside of any maintenance unit.

explanation: C is correct: the hierarchy is Workspace > Maintenance Unit > Dashboard Group > Dashboard. A is incorrect — cubes store financial data. B is incorrect — Origin dimension members are metadata elements. D is incorrect — dashboards must be within maintenance units.

question: What are two benefits of Workspaces in OneStream? (Select 2.)

options.A: They provide isolation between dashboards, allowing developers to work on the same dashboard in a sandbox environment.
options.B: They are used to organize dashboards within a maintenance unit.
options.C: They hold the structure of dashboards and all the elements necessary for creating dashboards.
options.D: They allow users to share Workspace objects with other Workspaces, enabling re-use of assets.

explanation: C and D are correct: Workspaces hold the entire structure and elements for dashboards, and they support sharing assets between Workspaces for reuse. A is incorrect — Workspaces do not enable simultaneous editing of the same dashboard. B is incorrect — organizing dashboards within a maintenance unit is the purpose of dashboard groups.

question: What is the most efficient way to locate a specific component within the tree view when in Design Mode?

options.A: Right-click on the component and select Highlight Component.
options.B: Enter the component name in the search box above the tree view.
options.C: Click the red triangle at the top right of the component.
options.D: Navigate manually through the maintenance unit tree.

explanation: C is correct: clicking the red triangle at the top right of a component in Design Mode takes the user directly to that component's location in the maintenance unit tree. A is incorrect — Highlight Component is not a standard menu option. B is incorrect — the red triangle is more direct than the search box. D is incorrect — manual navigation is the least efficient approach.

question: A consultant needs to make visual changes to a button on an existing dashboard. Where can these settings be adjusted?

options.A: By navigating to the button component, expanding the Formatting section, and adjusting the Display Format property.
options.B: By navigating to the button component, expanding the Formatting section, and adjusting the Template Parameter Values.
options.C: By navigating to the label component, expanding the Formatting section, and adjusting the Display Format property.
options.D: By navigating to the dashboard properties and adjusting the Layout properties.

explanation: A is correct: visual changes to a button are made in the Button component's Formatting section > Display Format property (e.g., MarginLeft = 23, TextColor = LightBlue). B is incorrect — Template Parameter Values passes parameter values, not visual formatting. C is incorrect — the button's formatting is on the Button component, not a label. D is incorrect — dashboard properties control layout structure, not individual component styling.

question: What is one way to control standardized formatting across dashboard components?

options.A: Input Value parameters.
options.C: Member List parameters.
options.D: Literal Value parameters.

explanation: D is correct: Literal Value parameters standardize formatting for Cube View columns/rows and dashboard components by centralizing formatting values into a single parameter. A is incorrect — Input Value parameters allow runtime value entry. B is incorrect — Member Dialog parameters launch a member selection dialog. C is incorrect — Member List parameters generate drop-down lists of dimension members.

question: An image needs to be updated on a dashboard with a new image hosted on a website. Which Image File Source Type should be used?

options.A: Workspace File
options.C: URL
options.D: Application Database File

explanation: C is correct: the URL File Source Type is used when the image is hosted on a website. A is incorrect — Workspace File is for images stored in the maintenance unit Files node. B is incorrect — File Share File is for network file shares. D is incorrect — Application Database File is for images stored in the OneStream database.

question: What does a Cube View MD data adapter provide that a standard Cube View data adapter lacks?

options.A: The ability to query data from an existing Cube View and display it in a dashboard.
options.B: The ability to display pivot tables similar to Excel.
options.C: The ability to display each OneStream dimension for each data point.
options.D: The ability to display advanced chart types such as radar, polar, and XY charts.

explanation: C is correct: the Cube View MD data adapter exposes each OneStream dimension (Entity, Consolidation, Scenario, Time, View, etc.) for every data point. A is incorrect — both adapters can display Cube View data. B is incorrect — pivot tables are a Pivot Grid component function. D is incorrect — advanced chart types are enabled by the Chart (Advanced) component.

question: Which dashboard components require a source of data (data adapter) in OneStream?

options.A: Pivot Grid, Chart, and Cube View.
options.B: Pivot Grid, BI Viewer, and Cube View.
options.C: Chart, BI Viewer, and Cube View.
options.D: Pivot Grid, Chart, and BI Viewer.

explanation: D is correct: Pivot Grid, Chart, and BI Viewer all require a data adapter. A, B, and C are incorrect — the Cube View component does NOT need a data adapter; it sources data directly from an existing Cube View.

question: What is the purpose of Files in relation to OneStream dashboards?

options.A: To write detailed commands to interact directly with databases.
options.B: To prompt for specific information and pull data from database tables.
options.C: To upload images and documents to create personalized, company-specific dashboards.
options.D: To display non-cube data such as user logon activity.

explanation: C is correct: Files in a maintenance unit are used to upload images, documents, and other assets that personalize and brand dashboards. A is incorrect — database commands are handled by SQL data adapters. B is incorrect — prompting for data describes parameters and data adapters. D is incorrect — displaying non-cube data is the function of data adapters.

question: What is the purpose of a BI Blend data adapter in OneStream?

options.A: To facilitate the query of BI Blend tables for users not familiar with writing SQL queries.
options.B: To display simple charts such as pie, line, bar, and donuts.
options.C: To query data from an existing Cube View and display it in a dashboard.
options.D: To write detailed commands to interact directly with databases.

explanation: A is correct: the BI Blend data adapter makes it easy to query BI Blend relational tables without requiring SQL query knowledge. B is incorrect — displaying charts is a component function. C is incorrect — querying a Cube View describes the Cube View data adapter. D is incorrect — writing database commands describes a SQL data adapter.

question: What is the correct order of steps needed to create a new structure for a dashboard in OneStream?

options.A: Create a maintenance unit > Create a Workspace > Create a dashboard group > Create a dashboard.
options.B: Create a Workspace > Create a maintenance unit > Create a dashboard group > Create a dashboard.
options.C: Create a maintenance unit > Create a Workspace > Create a dashboard profile > Create a dashboard.
options.D: Create a Workspace > Create a dashboard group > Create a maintenance unit > Create a dashboard profile.

explanation: B is correct: the sequence is Workspace first, then maintenance unit, then dashboard group, then the dashboard. A is incorrect — Workspaces must be created before maintenance units. C is incorrect — dashboard profiles are not part of the creation hierarchy. D is incorrect — maintenance units are created before dashboard groups.

question: Which option best follows the recommended naming convention for maintenance units in OneStream?

options.A: (OX)_My_Maintenance_Unit
options.C: My Maintenance Unit (XXX)
options.D: MyMaintenanceUnit(XXX)

explanation: C is correct: maintenance units should use spaces between words (title case) with a 2–4 letter solution code in brackets as a suffix — e.g., 'My Maintenance Unit (MU1)'. A is incorrect — the code goes at the end, not the beginning. B is incorrect — underscores are for components and data adapters, not maintenance units. D is incorrect — missing spaces reduce readability.

question: Which dashboard component does NOT need a data adapter in OneStream?

options.A: Chart
options.C: BI Viewer
options.D: Cube View

explanation: D is correct: the Cube View component does not need a data adapter because it sources data directly from an existing Cube View. A is incorrect — Chart components require a data adapter. B is incorrect — Grid View requires a data adapter. C is incorrect — BI Viewer requires a Cube View MD data adapter.

question: Which option best follows the recommended naming convention for data adapters in OneStream?

options.A: Cht-ClubAnalysis-DFM
options.C: cht_ClubAnalysis_DFM
options.D: CHT_ClubAnalysis_DFM

explanation: C is correct: data adapters use a lowercase three-letter type abbreviation prefix, meaningful name, and solution code suffix — all separated by underscores (cht_ClubAnalysis_DFM). A is incorrect — hyphens and a capital prefix are wrong. B is incorrect — mixed delimiters and full word prefix are incorrect. D is incorrect — the prefix must be lowercase.

question: What does the Substituted Query section show when testing a data adapter?

options.A: The original query with placeholders as entered.
options.B: A data table of query results.
options.C: The query after placeholders have been replaced with actual values or test parameters.
options.D: Query syntax errors detected during compilation.

explanation: C is correct: the Substituted Query shows the query with all placeholders replaced by actual test values. A is incorrect — the Original Query section shows the query as entered. B is incorrect — the Data Table section shows results. D is incorrect — syntax errors are not the purpose of this section.

question: Which data adapter properties allow an administrator to add extra dimension members to a Cube View MD data adapter?

options.A: Dimension To Level properties
options.C: Header Text properties
options.D: Loop Parameter properties

explanation: D is correct: Loop Parameter properties allow the administrator to add extra dimension members into a Cube View MD data adapter. A is incorrect — Dimension To Level controls which hierarchy level is returned. B is incorrect — Data Source defines where the Cube View data comes from. C is incorrect — Header Text controls dimension label display.

question: An administrator wants a Cube View MD data adapter to display the Scenario and Time dimensions by description only. Which properties should they amend?

options.A: Dimension To Level properties
options.C: Header Text properties
options.D: Loop Parameter properties

explanation: C is correct: Header Text properties define how dimensions are labelled in the results table — including showing by description only. A is incorrect — Dimension To Level controls hierarchy levels, not labels. B is incorrect — Data Source defines the data origin. D is incorrect — Loop Parameters add extra members, not labels.

question: Which dashboard building block should an administrator use each time a new dashboard is built?

options.A: 0_Frame_XXX
options.C: 3_Content_XXX
options.D: 4_Charts_XXX

explanation: A is correct: the 0_Frame_XXX dashboard is the main container (frame) that embeds all other dashboards and is the one deployed to end users. B is incorrect — the toolbar is an embedded sub-dashboard. C is incorrect — content is an embedded sub-dashboard. D is incorrect — charts is an embedded sub-dashboard.

question: An administrator needs to build a dashboard isolated from the rest of the application during development. What is the first step to set up the structure?

options.A: Create a maintenance unit.
options.C: Create a dashboard group.
options.D: Create a Workspace.

explanation: D is correct: the Workspace is the top-level organizational unit and must be created first to provide isolation. A is incorrect — maintenance units are created inside a Workspace. B is incorrect — dashboard profiles are for deploying dashboards, not initial structure. C is incorrect — dashboard groups are created inside maintenance units.

subtopic: Create Executive Dashboards — Cube View Data
question: In which two ways can an administrator utilize Cube View data on a dashboard? (Select 2.)

options.A: Drag and drop a Cube View into the BI Designer tool.
options.B: Create a Cube View component and add it to a dashboard.
options.C: Create a data adapter from a Cube View.
options.D: Use a data management sequence to supply data to a Cube View component.

explanation: B and C are correct: administrators can use a Cube View component (directly references a Cube View) or create a Cube View/Cube View MD data adapter (feeds data into Chart or BI Viewer components). A is incorrect — dragging a Cube View into BI Designer is not valid. D is incorrect — data management sequences perform calculations, not supply data to dashboard components.

question: Which dashboard layout type in OneStream organizes components into a fixed grid of rows and columns?

options.A: Tab
options.C: Grid
options.D: Horizontally Stack Panel

explanation: C is correct: the Grid layout organizes components into a fixed grid of rows and columns with configurable sizing. A is incorrect — Tab displays each component in its own tab. B is incorrect — Vertically Stack Panel stacks components vertically. D is incorrect — Horizontally Stack Panel stacks components horizontally.

question: An administrator needs a dashboard with six equal-sized components for comparative data analysis. Which layout type is best suited?

options.A: Vertical Stack Panel
options.C: Grid
options.D: Uniform

explanation: D is correct: the Uniform layout automatically distributes space equally among all components, ensuring consistent focus — ideal for comparative data analysis. A is incorrect — Vertical Stack Panel does not enforce equal sizing. B is incorrect — Tabs show one component at a time. C is incorrect — Grid provides flexible sizing but does not auto-enforce equal sizing.

question: In a Grid layout type, which property value allocates the most space within a column or row?

options.D: Auto

explanation: C is correct: 3* allocates three times the proportional space of a * component, making it the largest allocation among the options. A is incorrect — * allocates one unit of space, the base. B is incorrect — 2* allocates two units, less than 3*. D is incorrect — Auto adjusts to content size without taking proportional space.

question: An administrator needs the width of a Grid layout column to dynamically adjust based on the content within it. How can they do that?

options.A: Enter 1000 in the Column Width property.
options.B: Enter * in the Column Width property.
options.C: Enter # in the Column Width property.
options.D: Enter Auto in the Column Width property.

explanation: D is correct: Auto dynamically adjusts the column width to match the content size. A is incorrect — 1000 sets a fixed pixel width. B is incorrect — * allocates a proportional share, not content-based adjustment. C is incorrect — # is not a valid Column Width value.

question: Which diagram type is used to create pie charts and donut charts in OneStream?

options.A: Radar2D
options.C: Polar2D
options.D: XY2D

explanation: B is correct: Simple2D is the diagram type for pie and donut charts — best for comparing parts of a whole with a manageable number of parts. A is incorrect — Radar2D creates radar/spider web charts. C is incorrect — Polar2D creates polar charts. D is incorrect — XY2D creates scatter plots and waterfall charts.

question: A financial team wants to permanently see all amounts on a line chart at all times. What should the administrator configure?

options.A: Configure the Crosshair properties.
options.B: Configure the X-Axis and Y-Axis Text Format properties.
options.C: Configure the Point Labels properties.
options.D: Configure the Show Markers properties.

explanation: C is correct: set Show Point Labels to True and configure Point Label Text Format to permanently display values on the chart. A is incorrect — Crosshair shows values on hover, not permanently. B is incorrect — Axis Text Format controls axis label formatting. D is incorrect — Show Markers controls data point markers, not value labels.

question: How can an administrator add an image to display in an OneStream dashboard?

options.A: Upload the image in Application Properties.
options.B: Create a file within the maintenance unit, upload the image, add it to an Image component, then add the component to the dashboard.
options.C: Create a label within the maintenance unit, upload the image, then add the label to the dashboard.
options.D: Paste the image URL directly into dashboard layout properties.

explanation: B is correct: the process is create file > upload image > add to Image component > add to dashboard. A is incorrect — Application Properties is for application-level settings. C is incorrect — labels display text, not images; and the Image component is required. D is incorrect — URL images require the URL File Source Type, not pasting into layout properties.

question: An administrator is creating a Chart component and wants to see how it will look while configuring properties. What should they do?

options.A: Add the component to a dashboard.
options.B: Adjust the number of columns within the dashboard.
options.C: Adjust the margins of the chart.
options.D: Run a data management sequence to load data into the chart.

explanation: A is correct: the chart preview is only visible after adding the component to a dashboard. B is incorrect — adjusting column count affects layout, not chart appearance. C is incorrect — adjusting margins affects positioning. D is incorrect — data management sequences perform calculations, not chart previews.

question: Which properties need to be configured to display data values when hovering over a line chart in OneStream?

options.A: Crosshair Enabled, Diagram Type, and Type
options.B: Crosshair Enabled, Show Crosshair Labels, and Crosshair Label Text Format
options.C: Show Crosshair Labels, Crosshair Label Text Format, and Diagram Type
options.D: Crosshair Enabled, Diagram Type, and Crosshair Label Text Format

explanation: B is correct: Crosshair Enabled and Show Crosshair Labels must both be True, and Crosshair Label Text Format must be configured for hover-over value display. A is incorrect — Diagram Type is not required. C is incorrect — Crosshair Enabled is required. D is incorrect — Diagram Type is not required.

question: Which step can an administrator take to modify the title of a component shown on a dashboard without altering the component's name?

options.A: By updating the Description field.
options.C: By updating the Tooltip field.
options.D: By updating the Display Format field.

explanation: A is correct: the Description field displays a user-friendly title without changing the internal Name used for code references. B is incorrect — changing the Name can break code references. C is incorrect — Tooltip appears on hover, not as the displayed title. D is incorrect — Display Format controls visual styling, not the title.

question: An administrator wants a dashboard for comparative data analysis where space automatically distributes equally. Which layout type should they use?

options.A: Canvas
options.C: Vertical Stack Panel
options.D: Tabs

explanation: B is correct: Uniform automatically distributes space equally among all components — ideal for comparative analysis. A is incorrect — Canvas is freeform, not equal-space distribution. C is incorrect — Vertical Stack Panel stacks vertically without equal-space enforcement. D is incorrect — Tabs show one component at a time.

question: Which two options can be used to create a dashboard chart in OneStream? (Select 2.)

options.A: Using a Cube View component.
options.C: Using the BI Viewer component.
options.D: Using the Pivot Grid component.

explanation: B and C are correct: charts can be created using the Chart (Basic) component or the BI Viewer component's built-in BI Designer. A is incorrect — Cube View component displays data in a grid format. D is incorrect — Pivot Grid displays pivot table format data.

question: An administrator wants a dashboard layout that organizes components into rows and columns. Which layout type should they use?

options.A: Tabs
options.C: Horizontal Stack Panel
options.D: Canvas

explanation: B is correct: the Grid layout organizes components into defined rows and columns. A is incorrect — Tabs display components in separate tabs. C is incorrect — Horizontal Stack Panel stacks components side by side without a column/row grid. D is incorrect — Canvas is freeform positioning.

question: Which dashboard layout type offers the highest level of flexibility for component placement?

options.A: Wrap
options.C: Uniform
options.D: Canvas

explanation: D is correct: Canvas offers the highest flexibility — components can be placed anywhere by specifying exact position coordinates. A is incorrect — Wrap places components in sequence with automatic line wrapping. B is incorrect — Dock anchors to edges. C is incorrect — Uniform distributes space equally without freeform placement.

question: Which symbol is used in a Grid layout to distribute available space proportionally among all rows or columns?
explanation: C is correct: the asterisk (*) distributes available space proportionally — 2* gets twice the space of *, and 3* gets three times. A is incorrect — # is not a valid Grid sizing symbol. B is incorrect — ! is not valid. D is incorrect — / is not valid.

question: How can an administrator configure a chart to display data values only when they are hovered over?

options.A: Set Show Point Labels and Crosshair Enabled both to True.
options.B: Set Show Point Labels and Crosshair Enabled both to False.
options.C: Set Show Point Labels to False and Crosshair Enabled to True.
options.D: Set Show Point Labels to True and Crosshair Enabled to False.

explanation: C is correct: Show Point Labels = False (no permanent display) and Crosshair Enabled = True (show on hover) achieves on-hover-only display. A is incorrect — Show Point Labels True permanently displays values. B is incorrect — both False shows no values at all. D is incorrect — Show Point Labels True shows values permanently.

question: An administrator is beginning the process of building a new dashboard. What should be the first step they take?

options.A: Create the Workspace and maintenance unit.
options.C: Draft an outline of the dashboard's main elements.
options.D: Create a dashboard group.

explanation: C is correct: the first step is to draft an outline (wireframe) of the dashboard's elements before beginning construction. A is incorrect — while setup is early, planning comes first. B is incorrect — the header dashboard is created after planning. D is incorrect — dashboard group creation comes after planning.

question: Which type of parameter can users create to populate the values displayed in a simple combo box?

options.A: Input Value parameter
options.C: Member List parameter
options.D: Literal Value parameter

explanation: C is correct: Member List parameters create lists of dimension members using the Member Filter Builder, making them well-suited for populating combo boxes. A is incorrect — Input Value provides a text entry field. B is incorrect — Member Dialog launches a pop-up Select Member screen. D is incorrect — Literal Value hard-codes a formatting value.

question: An administrator wants the interaction with a component to update the dashboard by making a new connection to the database for fresh data. Which user interface action should they choose?

options.A: Redraw
options.C: Open Dialog
options.D: Refresh

explanation: D is correct: the Refresh action makes a new database connection to retrieve all current data. A is incorrect — Redraw redraws visually without a new database connection. B is incorrect — No Action produces no response. C is incorrect — Open Dialog opens a dashboard in a dialog window.

question: Where would administrators attach a dashboard to the workflow in OneStream?

options.A: Application > Workflow Profiles.
options.C: In the dashboard itself within Application > Workspaces.
options.D: Application > Workflow Channels.

explanation: A is correct: administrators go to Application > Workflow Profiles to add a workflow step and attach a dashboard to that step. B is incorrect — OnePlace > Workflow is for end users to access workflows. C is incorrect — Workspaces hold dashboard assets, not workflow configuration. D is incorrect — Workflow Channels define process structure, not where dashboards are attached.

question: Which OneStream feature ensures that all combo boxes on a dashboard are formatted consistently?

options.A: Navigation links
options.C: Redraw
options.D: Bound parameters

explanation: B is correct: Literal Value parameters centralize formatting values, ensuring consistent look and feel across dashboard components like combo boxes. A is incorrect — navigation links connect Cube Views for drill-through. C is incorrect — Redraw is a user interface action. D is incorrect — bound parameters pass values in the background.

question: What is the purpose of a dashboard profile in OneStream?

options.A: To make a dashboard group name visible to end users.
options.B: To make a maintenance unit visible to end users.
options.C: To make dashboards visible to end users in OnePlace, Workflow, and Excel.
options.D: To control which administrators can edit dashboards.

explanation: C is correct: a dashboard profile makes dashboards visible to end users by adding a dashboard group with correct visibility settings — making dashboards accessible in OnePlace, Workflow, Excel, and more. A is incorrect — profiles make dashboards visible, not group names specifically. B is incorrect — maintenance unit visibility is managed separately. D is incorrect — administrator editing access is managed through Groups and security settings.

question: How can an administrator prevent embedded dashboards from displaying in OnePlace?

options.A: Change the Layout Type to Embedded.
options.C: Change the Dashboard Type to Embedded.
options.D: Change the Dashboard Name to IsVisible=[FALSE].

explanation: C is correct: setting the Dashboard Type property to Embedded hides the dashboard from OnePlace while it still functions as an embedded sub-dashboard within a parent frame. A is incorrect — Layout Type controls component arrangement, not OnePlace visibility. B is incorrect — changing the Name does not control visibility. D is incorrect — IsVisible is not a valid Dashboard Name format for this purpose.
